name: nf-medicare
description: Establish Norfolk Island individual Medicare levy and surcharge treatment for 2026–27 using Australian legislation and current authority guidance. Covers ordinary low-income relief, family reductions, prescribed-person exemptions, part-year days, surcharge income tiers, hospital cover and reportable fringe benefits. Use for Norfolk Medicare tax, health levy, private hospital cover, family thresholds or surcharge questions. Includes statutory formulas, fictional computations and reviewer checks. Residence, dependency, cover and income adjustments require separate evidence. This source-cited reference preserves unresolved special cases and filing mechanics; it does not complete an individual return or the country pack.
